title: George RR Martin asks Stephen King: "How do you write so Fast?!"
summary: A short clip of George R.R. Martin asking Stephen King on stage how he writes so fast. King describes setting daily page goals, around six pages a day, and keeping focused hours.
why: Shared in productivity and writing threads for King's simple daily-quota approach to producing a lot of work.

quote.text: One of my favorite videos is when George RR Martin asks Stephen King on stage
